about: Recurring cast of the experiment log Shorts (format "xplog"). Drawn by shorts/design_kit/xplog-kit.jsx (XLChar who=<id> mood=…) — never redraw a cast member by hand. The narrator speaks to the viewer as "you"; the cast member is the viewer's stand-in on screen. People the viewer texts or meets (Sam, a boss, a date) stay grey avatars (XLAvatar). Append each episode to the character's history.
style: Thick ink outlines, big round heads with round white eyes, navy striped walls, cream UI cards, yellow accent #FFC93C, red #E5484D for alerts. HUD on top, one wide panel, sentence caption. Pictures: shorts/styles/xplog/.

finn.name: Finn
finn.look: yellow beanie with a white bobble, round glasses, teal hoodie
finn.personality: chronic overthinker; rereads everything he sends; calm on the outside, running twelve tabs inside
history: ep 1 (finn-left-on-read): texts Sam "we still on for Saturday?", left on read 23 hours, 7 spirals; Sam's phone had died
ep 2 cameo (gus-no-time): calls Gus at 5:30, goes to missed call

ep 2 (finn-cant-hang-up, with Ivy): wants to end a call with Ivy for ten minutes, 5 exit attempts (anyway, yawn, let you go, the time, okay bye); conversations rarely end when both want (Mastroianni, Gilbert, Cooney & Wilson 2021: about 2%); says "I've got to go", Ivy is relieved

ep 3 (finn-wrong-list, with Ivy cameo): lies awake at 11:48 PM listing what went wrong (the typo, the weird wave, a 2014 'you too' to a waiter); counting blessings (Emmons & McCullough 2003: ten weeks of weekly lists, the gratitude group felt better about life, more optimistic, fewer symptoms, more exercise); writes three things that went right

ivy.name: Ivy
ivy.personality: over-prepares; rehearses conversations in the shower; very funny once the plan falls apart
history: ep 1 (ivy-side-hustle, with Gus cameo): turns her drawing hobby into a shop; six weeks later she doesn't touch the pen on a free Sunday; overjustification effect (Lepper, Greene & Nisbett 1973: kids promised an award later drew about half as much); keeps one sketchbook NOT FOR SALE

ep 2 (ivy-heads-streak, with Gus): bets on Gus's coin flips; after 6 heads she's sure tails is due and doubles her bet; gambler's fallacy (Tversky & Kahneman 1971, law of small numbers; Monte Carlo 1913, black 26 times in a row); flip 7 is heads: the coin never kept score
ep 3 cameo (finn-cant-hang-up): on the other end of Finn's call, secretly tired too
ep 4 cameo (gus-name-letters): rolls her eyes at Gus, then quietly holds up an I
ep 5 cameo (finn-wrong-list): on Finn's 'went right' list ('Ivy laughed'); he hands her the list

gus.name: Gus
gus.personality: says he never overthinks; overthinks about that
history: ep 1 (ivy-side-hustle): cameo, thinking about which hobby he turned into a job

ep 2 (gus-no-time, Finn on the phone): rushed from 7 AM, says 'no time' five times, misses Finn's call and the sunset; awe expands perceived time (Rudd, Vohs & Aaker 2012: a one-minute awe ad vs a happy ad, awe viewers felt they had more time); day 2: one minute of sky before the inbox
ep 3 cameo (ivy-heads-streak): flips the coin, grinning
ep 4 (gus-name-letters, with Ivy): picks G because 'it just looks nice', then G, U, S in three letter-pair rounds; name-letter effect (Nuttin 1985, 1987: 12 languages, 2,047 students); hugs his G
